name: era5_brazil
publisher: ECMWF / Copernicus ERA5 reanalysis, served by the Open-Meteo archive API (Open-Meteo is named in the project's CLAUDE.md as a project source)
variables: daily maximum and mean temperature, precipitation, FAO reference evapotranspiration (ET0), 6 Brazil nodes
publication_delay: ERA5 preliminary values appear about 5 days after the day. Used at t-7 calendar days (the eval cuts at t-4; the candidate adds 3 days).
revision_policy: Preliminary values are replaced by final values after about 2 months. The file holds final values.
